preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: The length of each string n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == n and len(B) == n for n, A, B in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip(), input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: The lengths of strings A and B are equal to n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:20] for c in A) for A, _ in [(input().strip(), input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: String A contains only the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:20] for c in B) for _, B in [(input().strip(), input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: String B contains only the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters for each test case.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, _, _ in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip(), input().strip()) for _ in range(t)]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings A and B does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and (result >= 0 or result == -1) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer that is either non-negative or -1.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or result == min_moves(A, B) for result, A, B in zip(results, As, Bs))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the smallest number of moves required to make strings A and B equal, or -1 if it is not possible.
